set.body: Implement the shared runtime-rank codec program and compiler. Validate exactly one array-to-bytes transition, ordered bytes-to-bytes stages, sharding index programs, required executor identities, expected decoded sizes, and resource limits. Preserve unknown and ignorable extension behavior while returning precise unsupported-schema versus missing-executor errors. Gate: allocation-disciplined shared tests run unchanged on JVM and Scala.js, including invalid chains, limits, corrupt configuration, direct arrays, and start/end indexed sharding.
set.title: Zarr Z6.1: compile metadata into a lawful codec program
